title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts, update docs site
author: Ava Chen
description:
Context: This PR adds a small curated set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, plus language-specific tool-calling quickstarts (Python + TypeScript) and corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: provide opinionated, production-minded examples teams can copy into their apps and use as basis for dedicated/private deployments. The work is intentionally conservative: templates are focused, documented, and reference best-practices (prefix caching, minimal prompt scaffolding, explicit tool schemas).

What this PR includes (summary):
- new example agent templates under redwood-examples/rag/templates (qa-assistant, summarizer, customer-support)
- tool-calling quickstarts under redwood-examples/agents/tool-calling (python-example.py, typescript-example.ts) with README and minimal Dockerfile
- docs pages and guides under redwood-docs/docs/guides/rag-agent-quickstart.md and docs/reference/agent-templates.md; site navigation updated
- CI workflow for examples smoke tests (.github/workflows/quickstarts-ci.yml) to run lint, example-run smoke tests using a test API key stub
- sample config and environment variable guidance (sample-config.yaml)

Checklist:
- [x] Add templates and quickstarts
- [x] Add docs pages and nav entries
- [x] Add CI smoke job for examples
- [x] Address reviewer feedback (inputs, env var docs, example secrets warning)
- [x] Run docs build and examples smoke tests

Testing and verification:
- Local docs build: successful (jekyll/docs preview)
- Examples smoke: python and ts quickstarts run against staging mock endpoint in CI with a lightweight request and succeed
- Lint: python + ts linters report only minor style fixes applied

Migration / deployment notes:
- Docs site sidebar updated; changes are additive and non-breaking.
- Examples are opt-in; no runtime changes to production services.

Rollback plan:
- Revert the PR commit if any critical issue is discovered; docs and examples changes are isolated to docs and examples repos and will not affect runtime infra.

Related: ENG-2143 (RAG templates initiative), PM-872 (quickstart deliverable).

merge_commit_message: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; update docs site
release_notes: Added curated RAG agent templates and language-specific tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updated with user guides and reference pages. Examples include security guidance and a CI smoke test for future changes.
notes: This is an additive docs/examples PR intended to lower onboarding time for teams evaluating RAG workflows. No runtime code paths were changed.
